title: Approval of Proposed Amendments to the Emergency Water Conservation
text:
[N. Items for Approval]
Recommended by Water System
  Approval of Proposed Amendments to the Emergency Water Conservation
  Ordinance. All monies collected by LADWP pursuant to the penalty
  provisions of the Ordinance shall be collected for water conservation. All
  water conservation-related fines shall be recorded under General Ledger
  Account No. 6194151 Miscellaneous Water Revenues.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15060(c)(3).

  City Council approval is required by City Charter Section 240.

 O. Closed Session
  The Board shall recess into closed session for a conference with legal counsel
  regarding the below items:
